character: Independent, family-owned ski area in northeastern Pennsylvania just off I-81 north of Scranton, known regionally for challenging terrain and long, sustained runs. It is a skiing-focused operation with a single base area rather than a resort village.
learning: Group lessons run daily at 10:00 and 13:00, plus 17:45 Thu-Sat on night-skiing evenings. Meet at the ski school area at the base of the Beginner Slope. First-timer packages bundle a full-day beginner lift ticket, a first-timer group lesson and rental skis or snowboard. The PSIA-member school (75+ instructors) recommends new skiers take at least three lessons. Private 1-2 hour lessons can be reserved on weekends, subject to availability.

source.note: From NBC Pocono opening-date guides; per-year attribution is approximate.

season.typicalText: Typically opens in mid-December. Opened Dec 14, 2022; Dec 13 was the estimated/tentative first day in both 2023-24 and 2024-25. The 2025-26 opening date was not found.
season.notes: No official 2026-27 opening date found as of 2026-09-28. OnTheSnow (third party) projects an opening of 2026-12-11 and closing of 2027-03-21 (~100 days); these are projections, not announcements (https://www.onthesnow.com/pennsylvania/elk-mountain-ski-resort/ski-resort). In Jan 2026 the resort closed for a weekend during a major snowstorm for staff safety (https://fox56.com/news/local/too-much-snow-on-tap-elk-mountain-closes-until-monday-for-employee-safety). 2025-26 holiday-rate dates were Dec 24, 2025-Jan 1, 2026, Jan 19, 2026 and Feb 16, 2026.

research.confidenceNotes: WebFetch was blocked, so every figure comes from search-result summaries. Terrain stats come from Wikipedia and a SKI Mag / SnowBrains summary: 27 trails, 180 acres, 6 chairs + 1 rope tow, 100% snowmaking, 2 parks, 25/30/45 split. The ability split's category labels were ambiguous in one summary ('easy/difficult/more difficult'), but SnowBrains gives beginner/intermediate/expert. Hours come from the official lift-ticket page, which was updated Oct 2025. The 2025-26 holiday-rate dates were Dec 24, 2025 to Jan 1, 2026, Jan 19, 2026 and Feb 16, 2026. Opening-date history comes from NBC Pocono opening-date guides, and the exact attribution per year is approximate. Ownership comes from Unofficial Networks (Dec 2025) and First Tracks!! (2014). The summit coordinate is an estimate for weather queries only.
